course.title: Optics and Waves
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Let the displacement of a particle executing simple harmonic motion at any instant is given by, y=a sin(ωt+δ). Hence show that the total energy of a particle is proportional to the square of the amplitude of the motion. Also show that the principle of conservation of energy is obeyed by a harmonic oscillator.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
